ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Droid Repair Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Local friendlies bring their broken droids to the Jawa shop and pay for the work. What you fit into the machine is your business: a superior part buys a reputation, a worn one buys silver you keep, and a droid that never walks back out buys neither.
The customer layer on top of the Droidworks platform. Requires Droidworks — the job is resolved with its own repair bench and part-install recipes, not a parallel mechanism.
